verdicts.explanation: The 0.10 Ti sample (Li7La3Zr1.9Ti0.1O12) is reported as having 8.08×10-5 S/cm at room temperature with 0.37 eV activation energy, measured in this paper. Sintering at 1100 °C for 8 h, 91.8% relative density, solid-state synthesis, and Ti dopant all match the text.
